acceptance: Owner chooses an option; it is in place and a test or live observation shows a PR green on a stale base cannot land a combination that fails on develop.
context:
Consolidated duplicate item premerge-composed-tree-gap-red-trunk-20261101 (two individually green PRs breaking develop when merged without testing their composed tree).

Revalidated 2026-11-11: still required; waiting on an owner choice among (a), (b), (c). Current settings via gh api: develop ruleset develop-squash-only (id 15611785) still has strict_required_status_checks_policy false and no merge_queue rule (rules: pull_request, required_status_checks [core, explorer, results-data, docs, tooling, hold, review-gate, release-v2 probe], linear history, non-fast-forward, deletion); allow_auto_merge true; allow_update_branch false; no classic branch protection. scripts/pr_arm.py on origin/develop has no merge-tree or composed-tree check. Option (c) stays blind to merges after arming; (a) and (b) close the gap fully but interact with ci-queue-throughput-delays-arming-20261101, because every rebase restarts a CI wait (on 2026-11-11 evening: 19 runs queued, 21 in progress).
description:
Three times in three days two PRs, each green on its own base, merged within minutes of each other and broke trunk together: #3679 (omp pin) against goldens; #3836 against #3734 (trunk run 41166847029, test_redaction_scenarios); #3837 against #3899 (trunk run 41273143829, test_same_head_rerun.py: #3899 read plan run_uuid, #3837 removed it). The develop ruleset has strict_required_status_checks_policy false, auto-merge lands on checks from the old base, and make pr-arm checks only that trunk is green and the head has SHIP. An agent instruction to test a merge-tree with current develop before arming was not followed (#3837 armed at 04:26:26Z from a 03:54Z rebase, 14 minutes after #3899 merged) and would have run only touched tests.

Options for the owner: (a) GitHub merge queue on develop; (b) require branches to be up to date; (c) make pr-arm build a merge-tree with origin/develop and run tests/integration/oracle plus oracle unit tests, refusing on failure (oracle paths only; blind to merges after arming).
